blocks.text: Grade 5 高频词汇 901–953
disdain /dis'dein/ n. 蔑视；v.t. 蔑视, 鄙弃
A flapper was an independent woman in her 20s who demanded equality and who showed disdain for "acceptable" women's behavior.
中文语境：摩登女郎是指20多岁的独立女性，她们要求平等，并对"可接受的"女性行为表现出蔑视
firearm /'faiə'ɑːm/ n. 火器, 枪炮
The Europeans brought with them metal tools, firearms, and many other objects unknown in North America.
中文语境：欧洲人带来了金属工具、火器和许多其他北美未知的物品
immunity /i'mjuːniti/ n. 免疫, 免疫性, 免除；[化] 免疫性
Because they had never been exposed to these illnesses and had no built-in immunity, the diseases swept through the tribes.
中文语境：由于他们从未接触过这些疾病，也没有内在的免疫力，所以疾病席卷了整个部落
suspicious /sə'spiʃəs/ adj. 可疑的, 多疑的, 怀疑的；[法] 怀疑的, 令人怀疑的, 可疑的
There were Indigenous American tribes who were deeply suspicious of the Europeans, however.
中文语境：然而，有些美洲原住民部落对欧洲人抱有深深的怀疑
publication /.pʌbli'keiʃən/ n. 出版物, 出版, 公布；[经] 发布
As paleontologist Kristi Curry-Rogers told the publication Scientific American , "With nothing quite like sauropods today, our work on these creatures is akin to studying aliens."
中文语境：正如古生物学家克里斯蒂·库里-罗杰斯（Kristi Curry-Rogers）对《科学美国人》杂志所说的那样，"今天没有什么东西能像蜥脚类恐龙一样，我们对这些生物的研究类似于研究外星人。"
shelve /ʃelv/ v.t. 放置架子上, 搁置；v.i. 渐渐倾斜
Let's shelve the water plan for now."
中文语境：让我们暂时搁置供水计划吧。"
undisturbed /.ʌndi'stəːbd/ adj. 未被扰乱的, 安静的, 镇定的
Apparently, the wildlife groups considered the loss of one little dog or even two a small price to pay for leaving our wild visitors undisturbed.
中文语境：显然，野生动物组织认为失去一只甚至两只小狗只是为了让我们的野生游客不受干扰而付出的小小的代价
constituent /kən'stitjuənt/ n. 成分, 选民, 构成物；adj. 构成的, 组织的, 选举的
"As I believe the voice of my constituents and of all sensible and honest men is in favor of independence, my own judgment concurs with them.
中文语境："因为我相信我的选民和所有明智而诚实的人的声音都支持独立，所以我自己的判断也同意他们的观点
urgency /'əːdʒənsi/ n. 紧急, 催促；[法] 紧急, 迫切, 紧急之事
Feeling the urgency in his rider's voice, the horse stretched its legs, running harder and faster.
中文语境：马感受到骑手声音中的紧迫感，伸开双腿，跑得更猛烈、更快
unanimous /juː'næniməs/ adj. 意见一致的, 无异议的
Congress agreed that the vote must be unanimous - either all for or all against independence from England.
中文语境：国会同意投票必须一致--要么全部支持，要么全部反对从英国独立
tantrum /'tæntrəm/ n. 发脾气, 发怒；[医] 暴怒, 发脾气
They let her run around half wild, and she threw tantrums when she did not get her way.
中文语境：他们让她半疯地跑来跑去，当她不按自己的意愿行事时，她就会发脾气
zoology /zəu'ɒlədʒi/ n. 动物学, 动物区系；[医] 动物学
She learned arithmetic, zoology, geography, botany, and history.
中文语境：她学习了算术、动物学、地理、植物学和历史
blindness /'blaindnis/ n. 盲目, 失明, 愚昧；[医] 盲, 视觉缺失
The Kellers already had brought Helen to be examined by doctors, who told them that no operation could reverse Helen's deafness and blindness.
中文语境：凯勒夫妇已经带海伦去接受医生检查，医生告诉他们，没有任何手术可以逆转海伦的耳聋和失明
herbivore /'həːbivɒː/ n. 草食动物
They reveal whether the animal that produced the poop was a herbivore (plant-eater), carnivore (meat-eater), or omnivore (eater of both plants and animals).
中文语境：他们揭示了产生粪便的动物是食草动物（食植物）、食肉动物（食肉动物）还是杂食动物（既吃植物又吃动物）
omnivore /'ɒmnivɒː/ n. 不偏食的人, 杂食动物
They reveal whether the animal that produced the poop was a herbivore (plant-eater), carnivore (meat-eater), or omnivore (eater of both plants and animals).
中文语境：他们揭示了产生粪便的动物是食草动物（食植物）、食肉动物（食肉动物）还是杂食动物（既吃植物又吃动物）
gruesome /'gruːsəm/ adj. 可怕的, 令人毛骨悚然的, 阴森的
News of their gruesome discovery was a big deal and published in the scientific journal Paleontology and reported by the BBC .
中文语境：他们可怕的发现的消息引起了轰动，并发表在科学杂志《古生物学》上，并由英国广播公司报道
primitive /'primitiv/ n. 原始人, 早期艺术家；adj. 原始的, 上古的；[计] 图元; 原语; 基元
Other prehistoric sharks and primitive fish produced scroll-shaped feces that looked like a rolled sheet of paper, according to a study published in Science Reports .
中文语境：根据发表在《科学报告》上的一项研究，其他史前鲨鱼和原始鱼类产生的粪便呈卷轴状，看起来像一张卷起来的纸
fearsome /'fiəsəm/ adj. 吓人的, 可怕的, 害怕的
The fearsome serpent-like sea reptiles (plesiosaurs, mosasaurs and ichthyosaurs) also die out, as do the pterosaurs, the mighty winged reptiles that ruled the skies during the dinosaur era.
中文语境：可怕的蛇状海洋爬行动物（蛇颈龙、沧龙和鱼龙）也灭绝了，翼龙也是如此，翼龙是恐龙时代统治天空的强大有翼爬行动物
geographic /,dʒiə'^ræfik/ adj. 地理(学)的, 地区(性)的

As earthquake expert Rick Aster explained in National Geographic magazine, "[An] event of this size would be the equivalent of all the world's earthquakes for the past 160 years going off simultaneously."
中文语境：正如地震专家 Rick Aster 在《国家地理》杂志上解释的那样，"这种规模的事件相当于过去 160 年来世界上所有地震同时发生。"
equivalent /i'kwivələnt/ n. 同等物, 等价物, 相等物；adj. 相等的, 相当的, 同意义的；[计] 等价的

As earthquake expert Rick Aster explained in National Geographic magazine, "[An] event of this size would be the equivalent of all the world's earthquakes for the past 160 years going off simultaneously."
中文语境：正如地震专家 Rick Aster 在《国家地理》杂志上解释的那样，"这种规模的事件相当于过去 160 年来世界上所有地震同时发生。"
projector /prə'dʒektə/ n. 计划人, 发起人, 规划人, 放映机, 映画器, 幻灯机, 幻灯, 探照灯, 发射器；[计] 投影仪
T was writing on the projector, same as always.
中文语境：T 一如既往地在投影仪上书写
selfie /'sel.fi/ n. 自拍照
Sometimes his friends couldn't figure out how to hold their phones to fit him and everyone else in a selfie.
中文语境：有时，他的朋友们不知道如何握住手机以适合他和其他人的自拍
doodle /'duːdl/ v.i. 涂鸦, 混时间；n. 傻子
Kids were taking notes or doodling, same as always.
中文语境：孩子们一如既往地做笔记或涂鸦
outburst /'autbəːst/ n. 爆发, 突发, 破裂, 暴乱
T looked surprised at Javon's outburst.
中文语境：T 对 Javon 的爆发感到惊讶
awe-inspiring /'ɔːin,spaiəriŋ/ adj. 使人畏惧的
It was awe-inspiring for me," Rosenbaum said in an interview with Yale's Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.
中文语境：这对我来说是令人敬畏的，"罗森鲍姆在接受耶鲁大学艺术与科学研究生院采访时说道
ugly /'ʌgli/ adj. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的；n. 丑陋的人(或物)
Or the blobfish, rightfully named the world's ugliest fish, with its gelatinous face and drooping nose.
中文语境：还有水滴鱼，它有着凝胶状的脸和下垂的鼻子，被正确地称为世界上最丑的鱼
adaptable /ə'dæptəbl/ adj. 能适应的, 适合的, 可修改的
Diatoms are very adaptable.
中文语境：硅藻的适应性很强
hypothetical /,haipəu'θetikəl/ adj. 假设的, 有待证实的, 假定的, 有前提的；[计] 理想的
"The results from the DART mission are going to inform our hypothetical work on planetary defense going forward," said aerospace engineer Barbee.
中文语境："DART 任务的结果将为我们未来的行星防御假设工作提供信息，"航空航天工程师巴比说
understate /.ʌndə'steit/ v. 不完全地陈述, 保守地说, 有意轻描淡写
"It's going to be affecting the way we think about planetary defense mission design for many years to come, so the importance of the mission in that regard really can't be understated."
中文语境："这将影响我们在未来许多年对行星防御任务设计的思考方式，因此该任务在这方面的重要性确实不能被低估。"
coordination /kəu.ɒːdi'neiʃən/ n. 同等, 协调；[计] 协调; 进程协调
So, in 2016, NASA established the Planetary Defense Coordination Office to hunt asteroids that could threaten Earth before they become a problem.
中文语境：因此，2016年，美国宇航局成立了行星防御协调办公室，以在可能威胁地球的小行星成为问题之前搜寻它们
collaborate /kə'læbəreit/ v.i. 合作, 勾结；[法] 合作, 合著, 通敌
He works with governments and companies to reserve the launch date and collaborates with engineers and scientists to make sure take-offs go smoothly.
中文语境：他与政府和公司合作预定发射日期，并与工程师和科学家合作确保起飞顺利进行
leak /liːk/ n. 漏洞, 漏处, 漏出, 泄漏；v.i. 漏, 泄漏；v.t. 使渗漏
my pen leaked on my shirt,
中文语境：我的笔漏到了衬衫上，
rip /rip/ n. 裂痕, 破绽, 拉裂, 浪子, 巨浪；v.i. 被拉开, 裂开, 猛冲；v.t. 撕, 扯, 劈
When the kitten ripped the curtain,
中文语境：当小猫撕开窗帘时，
excavate /'ekskəveit/ v. 挖空, 挖出, 凿通
Children and adults can both help excavate, or uncover, fossils.
中文语境：儿童和成人都可以帮助挖掘或发现化石
unearth /.ʌn'əːθ/ v.t. 发掘, 掘出, 从洞中赶出, 揭露, 发现
Shouts of joy and surprise burst from around the site as volunteers exclaim as they unearth a fossil.
中文语境：当志愿者挖掘化石时，现场周围爆发出喜悦和惊讶的叫喊声
archive /'ɑːkaiv/ v.t. 把...存档；n. 档案馆, 档案文件；[计] 挡案库, 存档
It will be recorded in the Wyoming Dinosaur Center archive.
中文语境：它将被记录在怀俄明州恐龙中心档案中
vent /vent/ n. 排气口, 出口, 通风孔, 发泄；v.t. 发泄, 排出, 给...开孔

Kelly, a member of the research team and an expert on animals' rear ends, told the New York Times that most cloacal vents just look like slits or rounded holes, sometimes with wrinkly skin or scales around them.
中文语境：研究小组成员、动物臀部专家凯利告诉《纽约时报》，大多数泄殖腔泄殖腔看起来就像狭缝或圆孔，有时周围有皱纹的皮肤或鳞片
analogy /ə'nælədʒi/ n. 相似, 类似；[计] 模拟
Paleontologist Jakob Vinther, who studied the rear, used an analogy to explain its multipurpose wonders to Popular Science magazine: "It's the Swiss army knife of back ends."
中文语境：研究后部的古生物学家雅各布·温瑟 (Jakob Vinther) 用一个类比向《大众科学》杂志解释了其多功能奇迹："它是后端的瑞士军刀。"
release /ri'liːs/ n. 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书；v.t. 释放, 解除, 放松, 豁免, 免除, 发布, 放弃, 让与；n. 发布；[计] 版本, 发布
The researchers think Psittacosaurus may have been able to release its own dino-pleasing perfume, too.
中文语境：研究人员认为鹦鹉嘴龙也可能能够释放自己的令恐龙愉悦的香水
overlap /.əuvə'læp/ n. 重叠, 重复, 部分的同时发生；v.t. 重叠, 重复, 与...同时发生；v.i. 迭盖, 部分的同时发生；[计] 重叠
The area of the Ring of Fire has an almost unbroken series of subduction zones because so many tectonic plates overlap there, which is why 76% of the earth's seismic energy is released there.
中文语境：火环地区有一系列几乎不间断的俯冲带，因为有如此多的构造板块重叠在那里，这就是为什么地球76%的地震能量都在那里释放的原因
seismic /'saizmik/ adj. 地震的
It is the seismic (vibration) waves caused by this energy that create an earthquake.
中文语境：正是这种能量引起的地震（振动）波引发了地震
unbroken /'ʌn'brəukən/ adj. 未破损的, 未被征服的, 未打垮的, 不屈服的, 不涣散的, 整齐的, 未中断的；[法] 未被阻断的, 未破损的, 完好的
The area of the Ring of Fire has an almost unbroken series of subduction zones because so many tectonic plates overlap there, which is why 76% of the earth's seismic energy is released there.
中文语境：火环地区有一系列几乎不间断的俯冲带，因为有如此多的构造板块重叠在那里，这就是为什么地球76%的地震能量都在那里释放的原因
generate /'dʒenəreit/ v.t. 产生, 发生, 导致；[电] 产生
They monitor earthquake activity and any tsunami waves that might be generated and send out warnings.
中文语境：他们监测地震活动和可能产生的任何海啸并发出警告
methane /'meθein/ n. 甲烷, 沼气；[化] 甲烷; 沼气
As the body breaks down food, gases such as methane and carbon dioxide are released.
中文语境：当身体分解食物时，会释放出甲烷和二氧化碳等气体
digestion /di'dʒestʃən/ n. 消化力, 领悟；[化] 消化; 消化作用; 蒸煮; 蒸煮作用; 煮解; 浸提; 陈化
Passing gas is a natural result of digestion.
中文语境：排气是消化的自然结果
warehouse /'wєəhaus/ n. 仓库, 货栈, 大商店；v.t. 储入仓库
Most insects can be raised anywhere because they don't need wide, open spaces to roam - a cricket "farm" is really a warehouse filled with thousands of bins where the crickets live.
中文语境：大多数昆虫可以在任何地方饲养，因为它们不需要宽阔、开放的空间来漫游--蟋蟀"农场"实际上是一个装满了数千个箱子的仓库，蟋蟀生活在那里
herald /'herəld/ n. 使者, 传令官, 先驱；v.t. 预报, 宣布, 传达, 欢呼
"You have these iconic images of Triceratops doing battle with Tyrannosaurus rex ," paleontologist Caleb Brown told the Canadian newspaper Calgary Herald .
中文语境："你可以看到这些三角龙与霸王龙战斗的标志性图像，"古生物学家迦勒·布朗告诉加拿大报纸《卡尔加里先驱报》
rival /'raivl/ n. 对手, 竞争者；adj. 竞争的

The ceratopsians' horns may have added to their dashing looks in the eyes of potential mates, but they also probably helped the dinosaurs fight off rivals - much like two male antelope will lock horns and push each other back and forth until one gives up and leaves.
中文语境：角龙的角可能让它们在潜在配偶眼中显得英俊潇洒，但它们也可能帮助恐龙击退竞争对手--就像两只雄性羚羊会锁住角并互相推挤，直到其中一只放弃并离开
brontosaurus /.brɒntə'sɒːrəs/ n. 雷龙(古生物)
Between the two of them, they discovered Triceratops , Stegosaurus , Brontosaurus , Coelophysis and many other extinct animals.
中文语境：他们两人之间，发现了三角龙、剑龙、雷龙、腔骨龙等多种灭绝动物
geological /.dʒiəu'lɒdʒikəl/ adj. 地质学的, 地质的
Geological Survey, which gave him the power to make sure Cope's work didn't receive any government funding - a source of support that both scientists had relied on.
中文语境：地质调查局，这使他有权确保科普的工作不会得到任何政府资助--这是两位科学家都依赖的支持来源
rivalry /'raivlri/ n. 竞争, 对抗；[医] 拮抗
With that newspaper article, one of the most bitter rivalries in the history of paleontology - and maybe all of science - burst out into the open.
中文语境：随着那篇报纸文章的出现，古生物学史上--也许是整个科学史上--最激烈的竞争之一爆发了
bribe /braib/ n. 贿赂；v.t. 贿赂, 收买；v.i. 行贿
Behind Cope's back, Marsh bribed the miners to send the fossils directly to him at Yale University instead of to Cope.
中文语境：马什背着科普贿赂矿工，让他们将化石直接寄给他在耶鲁大学，而不是科普
vanity /'væniti/ n. 虚荣心, 虚无, 自负, 空虚, 时髦的小摆饰

"When I informed Professor Cope of it, his wounded vanity received a shock from which it has never recovered, and he has since been my bitter enemy," Marsh wrote in an 1890 letter to the New York Herald newspaper.
中文语境："当我把这件事告诉科普教授时，他受伤的虚荣心受到了打击，再也没有恢复过来，从此他就成了我的死敌，"马什在 1890 年写给《纽约先驱报》的信中写道
